elements.text: Acceptance scenarios before claiming the design works

elements.name: subtitle
elements.text: Tests target recurring research, real shutdown and the shared/private model boundaries.

elements.name: source
elements.text: Proposed checks. None is marked passed by this presentation or by the existence of these diagrams.

Scenario	Required observation
Findings change the plan	Actual Planner revises future work while accepted valid evidence remains usable
Independent work and local retry	One branch can repair while another continues; conflicting service writes serialize
Private model access	Another lab cannot reach its endpoint or read weights/checkpoints, including through shared gateways
CC model routing and contention	Container CC resolves an allowed alias after endpoint relocation; model pin, quotas and other clients survive lab stop
Hanging job and unresponsive lab	Supervisor verifies job termination; independent host/provider control stops the VM
Restart / restore	Persistent findings survive; old writer is fenced and uncertain effects are reconciled
